name: Vlad
source:
He is the mysterious man appeared in Kakeru's dreams, who also possesses the Eye of Aeon. [spoiler]It is revealed that he is King of Drasuvania. He was Liselotte's lover. It was because of his death that she decided to destroy the world using the "Black Moon".[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/11eyes:_Tsumi_to_Batsu_to_Aganai_no_Sh%C5%8Djo]Wikipedia[/url].]
